name: workspace
title: Workspace
description: A dockview workspace whose panels are the other items. Open panels, the active one and the layout are persisted per person as a file. Tools: workspace_open_panel(target, kind?), workspace_close_panel, workspace_focus_panel, workspace_list_panels.
docs: Needs @boring/viewers in your package.json. Call useWorkspaceLayout({ files, address: '/workspace/.boring/layout.json', kinds: [...] }) in your app, pass it as `workspace`, and render panels by kind with the other items.
